notes.title: New Game: Time Turned
notes.content:
Hey strategy game fans!

We have some thrilling news to share! One of our talented friends and fellow developer has just launched a brand-new puzzle game,[b] Time Turned[/b]. We're super excited about this release and we think you'll love it too!

[b]About Time Turned:[/b]
[i]Time Turned[/i] is a time-bending puzzle game where you use time clones to solve puzzles that would otherwise be impossible to complete alone.

You Should Check It Out!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2877110/Time_Turned/ 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41426392/f213494521417f0a6fd3cd06669764605c59d09f.png[/img]
You are the newest recruit to a world-famous organization of secret agents. With the time-bending stopwatch provided to you, you must work alongside past versions of yourself to solve puzzles and advance deeper into the secret lair of the evil Dr. Ineptus. Will you be able to foil his latest scheme before he sees his nefarious plot to completion?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41426392/7610063159c08d99c454aff017f9297fc867dbc6.png[/img]
The Organization's mystical stopwatch can freeze time, rewind it, and even create time clones. These temporal companions are perfect copies of the player that will replicate whatever the player has done taken since the beginning of each level. Cleverly utilizing these clones is essential to solving many of the challenges Time Turned presents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41426392/3522f51f4e1056e37156394fee12f1b3b36d3d29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41426392/66ada4bf527ba52dd20da6f1fc41a81de1981288.gif[/img]
